title: アイロン付き折畳み式アイロン台
titleEn: Folding ironing board with parked iron
description: ランドリー、衣装室や補修室の内装向けの、展開状態のアイロン台一式。先細りのパッド面、縁取り、交差した管脚と回転軸、接地ゴム、裏面の高さラック・固定したロック支え、開いた格子のアイロン受けと置いたアイロンを造形。台とアイロンは一つの完成備品として数えます。折畳み、加熱、蒸気・温度制御はありません。耐荷重・耐熱性や機器安全性は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.456 × 1.045 × 0.590 m、7,856三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A deployed ironing-board assembly for laundry, costume and repair-room interiors. It includes a shaped padded surface and binding, crossed tubular legs and pivot, rubber contacts, underside height rack and engaged fixed brace, open-bar iron cradle and parked iron. The board and iron count as one complete prop. Folding, heating, steam and temperature control are absent. Load capacity, heat resistance and equipment safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.456 × 1.045 × 0.590 m; 7,856 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
